settings.prompt.spellcheckHelp: Independent of interface language. DEAS checks prompt fields itself with a downloaded Hunspell dictionary; nothing leaves this PC.
settings.prompt.autocompleteHelp: Off by default. Uses Prompt Forge’s local tag database; requires a configured environment and its tag data. Type at least two characters, use arrows and Enter/Tab to choose; Escape dismisses.
settings.prompt.dictionaryMissing: No dictionary is installed for the selected language.
settings.prompt.failed: Could not configure spellcheck. See Logs for details.
settings.spellcheck.installed: Dictionary installed. Prompt fields are checked now.
settings.spellcheck.installHelp: Downloads the Hunspell pair for {language} ({size} MB, {license}) into the DEAS data folder — no admin rights, works on Linux and Windows.
settings.spellcheck.unavailable: No Hunspell dictionary is published for this language.
settings.spellcheck.failed: Dictionary download failed. See Logs for details.
